name: Vicinia
tagline: The calm, capable home for self-managed homeowners associations.
positioning: Vicinia gives volunteer boards one earnest place to collect dues, log violations, and keep the minutes — without a management company's markup.

hero.h1: Run your HOA like you actually enjoy your neighbors.
hero.sub: Dues, violations, meeting minutes, and reserve planning in one warm, unhurried workspace built for the volunteers who keep a community running.

features.title: Dues without the awkward emails
features.description: Send annual and monthly assessments, auto-remind late payers, and reconcile payments to each address — so treasurers stop chasing checks at the mailbox.

features.title: Violations with a paper trail
features.description: Log a fence repaint or an overflowing bin with photos, dates, and the exact bylaw cited. Vicinia builds the compliance letter and tracks every response.

features.title: Minutes that write themselves
features.description: Run the agenda, record motions and votes live, and publish approved minutes to owners the same night — no more retyping legal pad scribbles.

features.title: Reserve fund clarity
features.description: Model the roof, the pool pump, and the private road on one timeline so the board knows exactly when to raise assessments instead of guessing.

features.title: Architectural review, unstuck
features.description: Owners submit paint colors and deck plans through a form; reviewers approve, request changes, or deny — all timestamped for the next annual meeting.

features.title: One document library
features.description: CC&Rs, bylaws, insurance certificates, and vendor contracts live in one searchable place every owner and board member can find.

testimonials.quote: We were a spreadsheet, a shared inbox, and a lot of hard feelings. Vicinia turned our 34-home association into something I can actually hand off when my term ends.
testimonials.name: Marisol Reyes

testimonials.quote: The violation letters used to take me a full Saturday. Now I photograph the issue on my walk and the notice is drafted with the right covenant before I'm home.
testimonials.name: Dennis Whitlock

testimonials.quote: Owners stopped asking where the money goes. The reserve timeline is right there, and our special assessment vote passed because people could finally see it.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For small self-managed associations getting organized for the first time.
For active boards running dues, violations, and reserves together.
For larger communities with multiple committees and vendors.

homepage.footerBlurb: Vicinia is the earnest workspace for volunteer-run homeowners associations — collect dues, keep records, and govern with a little more grace.
